subject: planner: index join banned the enforced sort from stream agg, which is not supported in executor layer now. (#61324)
summary: Prevents generating enforced StreamAgg alternatives when planning an IndexJoin inner side (`prop.IndexJoinProp != nil`), avoiding plans that would require a sort-enforcer the executor path can’t build for index-join inner plans. Also fixes aggregation hint handling to only “return early for hint” when the hinted agg actually produced at least one physical alternative (avoids returning an empty plan set). `LogicalUnionScan` now forwards `PreparePossibleProperties` to its child, matching `exhaustPhysicalPlans4LogicalUnionScan` behavior of passing sort requirements through and the executor’s `UnionScanExec` keepOrder passthrough; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in the planner changes.
